definitions.explanation: The edition of a newspaper published and delivered in the morning, as opposed to the evening edition.

examples.japanese: {朝刊|ちょうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
⟦{今朝|けさ}→今朝：02877_kesa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{朝刊|ちょうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{載|の}っていた→載る：27882_noru⟧。
examples.english: That news was in this morning's paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧{朝刊|ちょうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{目|め}を{通|とお}す→目を通す：06904_mewotoosu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日課|にっか}→日課：00317_nikka⟧だ。
examples.english: My father's daily routine is to look through the morning paper while drinking coffee.

notes:
USAGE:
Major Japanese newspapers publish both a {朝刊|ちょうかん} (morning edition) and a ⟦{夕刊|ゆうかん}→夕刊：18550_yuukan⟧ (evening edition). Subscribers can choose to receive both or just the {朝刊|ちょうかん}. The morning edition is the larger of the two and contains the main news of the day.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {朝刊|ちょうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (to read the morning paper)
- {朝刊|ちょうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{載|の}る→載る：27882_noru⟧ (to appear in the morning paper)
- {朝刊|ちょうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{目|め}を{通|とお}す→目を通す：06904_mewotoosu⟧ (to look through the morning paper)
- {朝刊|ちょうかん}⟦{一面|いちめん}→一面：11184_ichimen⟧ (the front page of the morning edition)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{夕刊|ゆうかん}→夕刊：18550_yuukan⟧ (evening edition) is the counterpart, delivered in the afternoon or early evening.
